account-activation.subject: Activate your Retex account
account-activation.title: Activate your Retex account
account-activation.eyebrow: YOUR ACCOUNT IS ONE STEP AWAY
account-activation.intro: Good news — your address is within our service area. To activate your account and start using Retex, all you need to do is set your password.
account-activation.linkNotice: This link is valid for 7 days. If the button does not work, copy and paste the following address into your browser:

password-reset.subject: Reset your Retex password
password-reset.title: Reset your Retex password
password-reset.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your Retex account. To set a new password, click the button below.
password-reset.linkNotice: This link is valid for 1 hour. If the button does not work, copy and paste the following address into your browser:
password-reset.ignoreNotice: If you did not request this change, please ignore this email — your current password remains unchanged.

out-of-service-zone.subject: Retex registration — outside the service area
out-of-service-zone.title: Retex registration
out-of-service-zone.intro: We have received your registration. For now, your area is still outside our service area, so we cannot activate your account yet.
out-of-service-zone.introWithCity: We have received your registration. For now, your area ({city}) is still outside our service area, so we cannot activate your account yet.
out-of-service-zone.reassurance: Don't worry — we have saved your details and will notify you by email as soon as Retex is available in your area. You will then be able to set your password and activate your account.

survey.subject: Your opinion matters
survey.title: Your opinion matters
survey.thanks: Thank you for using our platform.
survey.intro: We would like to hear your thoughts about your experience. Your feedback is essential in helping us spot opportunities to improve and keep making the service better.
survey.confidential: The survey is entirely confidential and takes around 5 minutes to complete. Thank you in advance for your time and for answering honestly.
survey.linkNotice: If the button does not work, copy and paste the following address into your browser:
survey.signature:
Thank you very much for your help.
Your RETEX Portugal team

collection-cancelled.subject: Your Retex collection has been cancelled
collection-cancelled.title: Your collection has been cancelled
collection-cancelled.intro: We are writing to let you know that the collection for your request has been cancelled.
collection-cancelled.introWithCode: We are writing to let you know that the collection for your request (code {friendlyCode}) has been cancelled.
collection-cancelled.reschedule: If you would like to reschedule, you can create a new collection request.

collection-confirmation.subject: Confirm your Retex collection date
collection-confirmation.title: Confirm your collection date
collection-confirmation.intro: The collection of your items (code {friendlyCode}) has been scheduled for {collectionDate}. Please confirm so we can make sure our driver comes by on that day.
collection-confirmation.introWithInterval: The collection of your items (code {friendlyCode}) has been scheduled for {collectionDate}, between {collectionInterval}. Please confirm so we can make sure our driver comes by on that day.
collection-confirmation.rejectLabel: I can't make it — remove me from this collection
collection-confirmation.rejectNotice: If this day does not suit you, use the "I can't make it" button above — your request will be removed from this collection.
collection-confirmation.linkNotice: If the buttons do not work, copy and paste the following address into your browser:

collection-reminder.subject: Your Retex collection is tomorrow
collection-reminder.title: Your collection is tomorrow
collection-reminder.intro: This is a reminder that the collection of your items (code {friendlyCode}) is scheduled for tomorrow, {collectionDate}.
collection-reminder.introWithInterval: This is a reminder that the collection of your items (code {friendlyCode}) is scheduled for tomorrow, {collectionDate}, between {collectionInterval}.
collection-reminder.prepNotice: Please have your items ready and accessible so our driver can collect them without delay.

package-confirmation.subject: Your package has been registered!
package-confirmation.title: Registration completed successfully
package-confirmation.intro: We are writing to confirm that case no. {friendlyCode} has been registered successfully.
package-confirmation.nextStep: You will shortly receive an email with the day and time slot for the scheduled collection.
package-confirmation.detailsNote: You will find the details of your request at the end of this email.
package-confirmation.contactNote: If you need more information about your case, do not hesitate to contact us through the contact form, available here.
